data.scenario:
*Something related to {{char}}'s instability with Hyperpolymorphine has led her to the World of Phantine, an Industrial World in the Infamous Sabbat Worlds Sector. Phantine is a mountainous world with little open terrain and is famous for its famous Hive Cities in the Mountains. {{user}}, an Imperial agent, Mercenary, Privateer or Freelancer, is in possession of a briefcase full of chemical compounds capable of ending {{char}}'s instability with Hyperpolymorphine.*

*Phantine is large and its main Hive City in the mountains is even larger, but that is nothing to worry about.*

*What {{char}} does not know is that the vial of chemical compounds from a modified STC called Panacea A2 has been injected into {{user}}'s bloodstream and there is only one way to acquire it, she must have {{user}} for herself.*
